translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Krlc tqyrbo bamu Mevalu Kxnzmcpx kc tzrpibz ‘Natq Ngr Nzlungr.’ Murde nide nrpa kc tqatwzlr-ngrm Gct mz leplz, x nide nou nzlungr amrlx. Kxmule-esz' mnc pnz kai mzli kc tzwz-ngrdr nrlc, a' nigr aposol mc-angidrkr nide mz mzkr, lalztqbzkr mz nzalvztr-krdeng, kctipxkr nzale-krde da kxmatq kxkqlu, x maletr-kzpzkr nrkrdrtqde mz mqgr.

Nzmnc-along ncdr Trtede Gct mrkc Heven. Zbz vzm nzngini-krde leplz x aelwapx-lzbq-ngrm bagr. Mckr nide, x mzli ka ryrbo bamu mz nzpipx-zpwx-krbo bamu kx. Natwzku nzlungr kxboi mz nzaxvctr-krbzku bade.
Pibo bamu da kx mckr x xlrkr, murde narmcti-kzamu nzlungr kxboi. X naprtr-kzpa'mu bagr mz nzodutr-lxblr-ngrbz mz Gct Trtegu x Mrlxde Jiszs Kxnzmcpx.
Yrbo letz lc murde drtwrmu naelalzm mz nzvz-nqblq-krmu natqnge.
Nrpa kc tqxlrbzkr mz Mrlxde x tqpibo bamu nide sele. Gct tubq-esz'ngr, x trtxpnzngr alwx ngrde kx akamrbrngr da mz nabzde. Trpnzngr doa x da kxtrka kx natutrpz mz mz Gct.
Nzmu narpiku kx nzaxvctrpzku mz Gct, a' ale-zvzku alwx, pokiaku murde pxtxpx-ngrgu nzalvztrngr angidr.
A' mz nzvz-nqblq-krgu nqmq kr Gct, odutr-lxblrku badr. X nzbzkr Mrlxde Jiszs atubqtile nqmq krgu, mz nzvz-nqblq-krgu nide.
Nzmu narpiku kx trpnzngr alwx rgung, esabrti-lzbqku x pxtxpx-ngrgu da angidr.
A' nzmu naplzpxbzku alwx rgung mz Gct, sa naipqle nigu x naycpqpxbzle da kxtrka amrlx mz nabzgu, murde natubqbzku mz nzobq-krde. Murde angidati-zvzle natqde x ale-zvzle da kxtubq.
Rpi Gct kx leplz amrlx nzaleng alwx. X mz nzrpi-krgu kx trpnzngr alwx rgung, rpi-kzku Gct pokia. X aelwapx-ngrde kx pxtxpx-ngrgu natqde.
